posts.text: 📝 Don't rush to bury it 📝 Return of « Disk » to service In October, we drew attention to how Yandex specialists dealt with the consequences of strikes on data centers. Despite equipment damage and service disruptions, the company managed to restore operations fairly quickly. And fresh results confirm this. The company announced the restoration of access to 99.55% of data on Yandex Disk . Auto-upload of files from smartphones, archive downloads, and video playback are working again. The remaining data continues to be restored. The consequences of the attacks have not yet been completely eliminated, however, the main functions of the service are operating normally. Therefore, there is clearly no reason to panic over reports of malfunctions. Specialists continue restoration efforts, and the results of their work speak for themselves . 🖍 At the same time, the attacks themselves clearly demonstrate how much today depends on digital infrastructure . Data centers and network nodes ensure the operation of payment systems, communications, logistics, and enterprises. Disruptions in their operation can affect millions of users. ❗️ Digital infrastructure in the modern world has become one of the most important elements of any state's life. Therefore, studying such attacks and their consequences helps better understand the vulnerabilities of the enemy and its recovery capabilities when planning one's own operations. #mediatechnology #Russia #Ukraine ✉️ MAX 💸 Support us Original msg

​​ Переправлення ухилянтів через Придністров’я: ВАКС застосував запобіжний захід до організатора злочину Слідчий суддя ВАКС застосував запобіжний захід у вигляді 500 тис. грн застави до особи, яку слідство вважає організатором схеми незаконного переправлення військовозобов’язаних чоловіків через Придністров’я до країн Європи. Суд також поклав на підозрюваного такі процесуальні обов’язки: - прибувати на кожну вимогу до детективів, прокурорів та/або суду; - не відлучатись за межі Львівської області без дозволу детективів та прокурорів; - повідомляти детективів, прокурорів про зміну свого місця проживання та/або роботи; - утримуватися від спілкування щодо обставин, викладених у чинному повідомленні про підозру, з визначеним колом осіб; - здати на зберігання органу Державної міграційної служби України свій паспорт (паспорти) для виїзду за кордон та інші документи, що дають право на виїзд з України. Зазначимо, що наразі у справі завершено досудове розслідування. Детективами НАБУ за дорученням прокурора САП відкрито матеріали справи стороні захисту для ознайомлення. 📌 Відповідно до ст. 62 Конституції України особа вважається невинуватою у вчиненні злочину і не може бути піддана кримінальному покаранню, доки її вину не буде доведено в законному порядку і встановлено обвинувальним вироком суду.

📝 Wikipedia issued a warning 📝 Wikipedia could be banned in Russia. The Prosecutor General's Office sent Wikimedia Foundation, which owns Wikipedia, a warning: its activities could be recognized as undesirable because the foundation conducts a "targeted information campaign to destabilize the situation" in the country. 🖍 The warning was issued under the law on measures against persons involved in violations of the rights and freedoms of Russian citizens. If "destructive anti-Russian activities" continue, Wikimedia Foundation will be recognized as an undesirable organization. For now, this is just a warning, not a decision. The foundation has the opportunity to change its approach. But judging by how Wikipedia is structured, there's little reason to expect that. 🚩 Complaints about Wikipedia have been voiced for a long time. Articles about World War II, the history of Russia and the USSR, and events in so-called Ukraine are repeatedly rewritten from anti-Russian positions. Anyone can edit them, so in reality the content is determined by the most active and organized authors, and they are mostly from countries unfriendly to Russia. 🏳️ Even the project's creators themselves say this. In August, Wikipedia co-founder Larry Sanger in an interview with Berliner Zeitung called it a "propaganda organ". According to him, due to anonymity rules, the encyclopedia is easy to use for propaganda purposes and the CIA has already edited it. Sanger also speaks of "left-liberal bias" among leading editors and believes that the resource is compromised as a source even for training neural networks. 📌 So the Prosecutor General's warning was long overdue. Reports that Wikipedia is edited in the interests of unfriendly countries and historical events are distorted have accumulated in abundance. If even one of its creators acknowledges CIA involvement, there's no point in talking about a "free encyclopedia". But it's important to look broader and think about an alternative. After all, not long ago Wikipedia was for many almost the only source of reference information. ❗️ But with the advent of neural networks, everything has changed: it's easier to ask an AI a question and get an answer right away than to read articles one by one. Therefore, building your own reference information space needs to follow the same principles. There's no point in creating another Wikipedia clone. It's much more useful to train your own AI models on a verified knowledge base: domestic books, scientific works and archives. Otherwise, questions about Russian history will continue to be answered by neural networks trained on the same articles rewritten overseas. #mediatechnology #Russia #USA ✉️ MAX 💸 Support us Original msg

🇷🇺 🇺🇦 ⚡️ — Russia launches a large-scale strike on Ukrainian defense industry facilities, energy infrastructure, transport networks and military logistics using missiles and drones, according to the Russian Defense Ministry. • Kyiv region: Strikes hit an explosives and gunpowder facility in Brovary, a UAV assembly plant and the Fire Point missile assembly facility in Petrovskoe. • Lviv region: The Lviv Aviation Plant and the Zapadno-Ukrainskaya power substation in Khodoriv were hit. • Energy infrastructure: Strikes targeted the Burshtyn thermal power plant in Ivano-Frankivsk region and substations in Dnipropetrovsk, Chernihiv and Lviv regions. • Transport infrastructure: The Zatoka road-rail bridge in Odesa region, bridges in Kyiv region and railway locomotives in Dnipropetrovsk and Zhytomyr regions were hit. • Military logistics: A dry cargo ship carrying military supplies to Odesa was hit at sea. A warehouse in Mykolaiv region used to store cruise missiles was also struck. @Intelslava
